source: RFC 0014 §3 R1, R2, R6, T (the coordinator's ruling of 2026-11-24 on phase 2 of the cross-version fixture); the red-team inventory, row 20
statement: Kafka events are not exchanged between versions of CoSec: CoSec writes decision and change events for consumers outside it and reads none back, so their payload is a contract with those consumers only.
guards: compat:LocalStateCompatTest#no module of CoSec consumes Kafka
